scope: Independent infrastructure aggregate requirements and clean candidate source

before.observation: Actual Tier-1 reports relabelled full were accepted even though an additional repository test was absent.

scenarios: Six full fixture files execute across three partitions and reconcile.
Five genuine Tier-1 fixture files execute and reconcile.
Consistent reduced coverage relabelled full is rejected and marked incomplete.
Dirty/missing source metadata, changed checkout, stale/missing candidate SHA, invalid mode and failed jobs reject.
Existing stale, missing and substituted shard reports still reject.

limitations: Behavioral verification uses real Vitest execution in temporary repositories; it does not run the entire product infrastructure suite.
The infrastructure aggregate workflow can still be skipped with its selector; global always-emitted gating and effective required protections remain open.
No current native CI readiness or publication claim.
